mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_data (installation_id, collection_name, data_key, data_json) VALUES (#{installationId}, #{collection}, #{dataKey}, CAST(#{dataJson} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data_json = VALUES(data_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM plugin_data WHERE installation_id = #{installationId} AND collection_name = #{collection} AND data_key = #{dataKey}
